thread:
sarah-ae: FYI — ACME wants a 2-week POC starting Mon. They're asking for Dedicated pool autoscale + short bursts. Need to confirm if we can do baseline 4 GPUs and allow burst to 16 for up to 2 hours/day. Can we support that without a long reservation?

matt-se: Context: POC will run generation-heavy workloads (gpt-like open model) — typical sustain ~300 rps, spikes to ~1200 rps for ~5–10min. They'll test multi-user concurrency. They asked about cost and whether burst is guaranteed.

jena-infra: Short answer: two options — soft burst (best-effort) or reserved capacity. Soft burst = we scale up by pulling from pool surplus if available; no SLA and could be throttled during cluster pressure. Reserved capacity = we create a short-term reservation (we can do 2 weeks) which guarantees GPUs but needs 48–72h lead time to provision.

kevin-pp: Pricing note: For short-term reservations we can offer a promotional rate: 30–40% off list for 2-week POCs, charged pro-rata daily. For soft-burst usage we bill on-demand at standard Dedicated rate plus surge premium for >baseline throughput. Will confirm exact numbers once infra confirms capacity impact.

matt-se: For the customer, they need exact config to validate with their security/compliance: what API keys and VPC secrets they'll need, and whether this affects data isolation. Also asked: can we restrict burst to certain models and regions?

jena-infra: Yes — burst policy is configurable per-pool and supports allowed_models and allowed_regions. We can scope the POC pool to the ACME account and lock to redwood-gpt-8k only, region eu-west-1. Example policy (what we'll send to them):

```json
{
  "pool_name": "acme-poc-eu1",
  "baseline_gpus": 4,
  "burst_cap_gpus": 16,
  "burst_window_minutes": 120,
  "burst_strategy": "best_effort", // options: "best_effort" | "guaranteed"
  "allowed_models": ["redwood-gpt-8k"],
  "allowed_regions": ["eu-west-1"],
  "scaling_cooldown_seconds": 300
}
```

jena-infra: If they want guaranteed bursts we create a reservation object: 

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_reservation" "acme_poc" {
  pool = "acme-poc-eu1"
  gpus = 12 # additional over baseline
  start = "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
  end   = "2026-04-15T00:00:00Z"
  commitment_type = "short_term"
}
```

matt-se: Perfect. For the SC we should ask ACME to sign the short-term reservation T&C. If they prefer soft-burst, warn about noisy neighbors and potential throttling.

kevin-pp: I'll draft the pricing addendum and include an example invoice. Also include surge billing examples: baseline at reserved rate, burst usage billed at on-demand rate + 20% premium.

jena-infra: Operational tasks for us: 1) create dedicated pool acme-poc-eu1, 2) create role binding redwood:engineer -> pool:modify for @matt-se, 3) provision API key scoped to pool with env tag, 4) add cluster autoscale policy. I can do (1) and (4) if infra approves.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #IR-4521 — "ACME POC: create dedicated pool + autoscale/burst" — assignees: jena-infra, infra-oncall. ETA: 48h for soft-burst config; 72h+ for reservation provisioning.

sarah-ae: Deadline: customer needs pool and API key by Mon EOD. If reservation needed we must get signed addendum by Thu. Can we meet that?

jena-infra: For soft-burst we can meet Mon EOD. For guaranteed reservation, ask legal to expedite addendum. I'll start pool create tonight and post the pool endpoint once ready.

matt-se: I'll follow up with ACME and confirm whether they want guaranteed burst. Sarah — ping me once you have their decision, I'll send the policy JSON and an example cURL to test. Example cURL: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDSHIFT_POC_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-8k","input":"hello"}' \
  https://dedicated.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sarah-ae: Thanks all — I'll update after today's call. :thumbsup:
